codeGeneration.label: Explicit OpenAPI code generation and its tooling
codeGeneration.observation: The codegen command reads checked-in openapi.yaml. It is absent from normal install/build scripts; generated schemas can be imported by the API scaffold. Untrusted specifications or refs require separate review.

browserBuildTools.label: Browser build/development tooling
browserBuildTools.observation: Vite/React/Tailwind build inputs and development servers, not browser CAD file parsing. Both Vite configs bind 0.0.0.0 with allowedHosts:true. Production exposure is not established by local source.

serverRuntime.label: Optional API-server scaffold runtime
serverRuntime.observation: Express middleware parses JSON and extended URL-encoded bodies; current static route is /api/healthz. Actual public API exposure and request-specific exploitability were not tested.

serverBuildTool.label: API-server build tooling
serverBuildTool.observation: esbuild is called through its build API. No esbuild development-server call was found in the build script.

unusedBrowserScaffold.label: Unreferenced browser chart scaffold
unusedBrowserScaffold.observation: Recharts imports exist only in ui/chart.tsx; neither current browser entry graph reaches that file. No direct Lodash call was found in app source. This is source reachability, not a final bundle or exploit proof.

typeDependency.label: Type-definition dependency
typeDependency.observation: fflate is reported through @types/three. No fflate/unzipSync application import or call was found; STEP/project file handling is not this ZIP parser.

mockupTooling.label: Separate mockup-sandbox tooling
mockupTooling.observation: fast-glob/micromatch path belongs to the scaffold mockup workspace, separate from the CAD and landing entry points.

sourceInspection.method: TypeScript AST walk of value imports/exports, literal dynamic imports and worker URL/query imports from both main.tsx entries; declaration-only imports excluded. Installed non-peer dependency closure of those external imports also collected. No exploit payload, browser runtime reachability or final bundle analysis performed.
